milestones.name: Phase 1 and Phase 1A - Planning Inputs and Migration Support Review
parallel_execution_guidance: run MIG-001, MIG-003, MIG-004, and MIG-005 in parallel
start MIG-002 only after MIG-001 closes
do not block skill or script review behind governance-data cleanup
acceptance: validate-governance-artifacts.mjs enforces the same minimum invariants as the Python tests
custom skills and migration-support scripts are reviewed and classified as fit for purpose before they are used as execution infrastructure
token-enforcement expectations are defined for any route touched by migration work
wireframe workflow documentation and validation exist for canonical XML wireframes before Phase 3 execution starts

items.title: Fix capability matrix completeness
deliverables: add missing resolution_status values
add missing blocked_by and resolved_commit metadata where required

items.title: Align governance validator with tests
deliverables: validator checks capability status fields, not just ids
validator agrees with Python plan tests on pass/fail

items.title: Review migration skills for fit-for-purpose
deliverables: review sprint-coordinator, frontend-backend-mapper, api-contract-validator, migration-audit, and verification-before-completion
classify each as approved, approved_with_limits, or not_fit_for_purpose
record exact allowed use and known limits

items.title: Review migration scripts for fit-for-purpose
deliverables: review validate-governance-artifacts.mjs and component-inventory.ts
confirm whether outputs match the route matrix and component gap map
identify any script that must be corrected before it can be treated as a gate

items.title: Define token-enforcement gate for touched routes
deliverables: define the default token-enforcement grep for touched route files: rg --type-add 'tsx:*.tsx' --type-add 'ts:*.ts' '#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,6}|rgb\(' frontend/src/pages frontend/src/features frontend/src/layouts
require migration work to explain any allowed exceptions, such as style-guide or test fixtures
identify which review steps enforce token compliance during migration
completion_evidence: milestone closure includes the grep result for touched route files and any justified exceptions

items.title: Document and validate the wireframe workflow
deliverables: record prior wireframe-process learnings, reuse guidance, and workflow do/don't rules in the tracked migration docs
add a deterministic validator for canonical XML wireframes and planning-artifact consistency
validate wireframes against the route matrix, component gap map, and asset-integrity warnings before Phase 3 execution
completion_evidence: scripts/validate-wireframe-workflow.py runs against the repo and emits a structured report
tracked migration docs capture the prior-failure analysis and the current workflow sequence
the workflow explicitly separates validated wireframes, build contracts, tokens-first gap-fill planning, and later implementation-spec work

items.title: Generate route-level wireframe build contracts from canonical XML
deliverables: add the tracked build-contract prompt artifact to the migration docs
use the exact prompt to generate deterministic build contracts for priority routes
ensure each build contract reconciles canonical XML wireframes with the route matrix and backend-feature component gap map
record blocking contract_gap findings instead of inferring missing ownership or components
completion_evidence: at least one priority-route build contract is approved, not merely generated
the approved output uses the required XML contract schema, contains no code generation, and leaves no build-critical ownership decisions unresolved

items.title: Derive tokens-first gap-fill plans before component build work
deliverables: add a tracked tokens-first gap-fill workflow artifact to the migration docs
add a deterministic planner that compares route ownership, component gaps, approved build-contract inputs, and existing runtime TSX files
classify each target component as reuse_as_is, keep_behavior_rewrite_styling, keep_behavior_extend_tokens, reference_only, build_new, or blocked
prevent token-dirty runtime presentation from being reused as canonical implementation without rewrite
completion_evidence: scripts/derive-gap-fill-plan.py generates a route-level JSON plan
the tracked docs explain the tokens-first reuse formula and thresholds
route-level implementation specs can distinguish behavior reuse from presentation reuse

milestones.name: Phase 2.1 and Phase 2.2 - Applications and Smart Ingestion
acceptance: /career/ingest owns one canonical upload-to-save flow on /api/v1/ingest

items.title: Replace mock-backed applications flow in /tracker
deliverables: confirm mounted applications CRUD endpoints and the frontend API client match the intended tracker data flow before replacing mocks
wire list view to real application data
remove mock-only path from main tracker flow
completion_evidence: tracker reads real backend data in the normal flow
the contract check against mounted backend endpoints is recorded

items.title: Add application detail, edit, and status flows
preconditions: MIG-101 has confirmed request and response shape for detail, edit, archive, and status actions
deliverables: support detail, edit, status transition, and archive behavior in tracker

items.title: Converge ingestion on /api/v1/ingest
deliverables: confirm /api/v1/ingest remains mounted in backend/app/main.py
inventory current ingestion callers across /api/v1/ingest, /api/career/ingest, /api/ingest/artifacts/upload, and /api/ingestion/*
classify each caller as canonical, transitional, or deprecated
route active ingestion behavior through /api/v1/ingest
stop treating overlapping ingestion paths as canonical
completion_evidence: active ingestion path uses the canonical contract
the caller inventory and canonical/deprecated classification are recorded

items.title: Build the routed smart-ingestion flow
deliverables: support upload, tag confirm, and save as one routed flow

milestones.name: Phase 2.3 and Phase 2.4 - Voice Profile and Documents Redline

items.title: Add redline workflow ownership to /documents
deliverables: confirm the mounted document redline and review contracts before building route-owned UI
expose redline and review workflow inside documents route
completion_evidence: documents route exposes redline and review workflow without creating a new top-level route
the document redline contract check is recorded

items.title: Add voice profile management to /profile
deliverables: make profile route the visible owner of voice profile management

milestones.name: Phase 2.5 and Phase 3 Support - Resume Audit, Jobs, and Explicit Deferrals
milestones.phase_3_backlog_expansion_note: before broad Phase 3 route migration starts, expand this milestone from the route matrix so each affected product area has its own implementation or deferral item
acceptance: /analysis supports minimum viable resume audit flow
jobs family has a clear place for job analysis results
blocked capabilities remain deferred rather than half-built

items.title: Decide and wire the minimum viable resume audit flow
deliverables: launch and display audit evaluation results from analysis route

items.title: Add the canonical job analysis results surface
deliverables: provide one canonical result surface for current job analysis flows

items.title: Keep workflow orchestration explicitly deferred
deliverables: mark orchestration UI as blocked on backend readiness

milestones.name: Phase 3 and Phase 4 - Route and Component-Library Cleanup
acceptance: /kr/* routes are no longer part of product truth
reference-only components are clearly distinguished from canonical route-owned components

items.title: Retire prototype /kr/* routes from live product routing
deliverables: remove /kr/* routes from product truth
preserve useful patterns only by merging them into canonical routes

items.title: Mark reference-only components and cleanup candidates
deliverables: mark reference-only and cleanup candidates in component inventory

items.title: Verify token and dependency integrity after route cleanup
deliverables: verify touched routes remain token-compliant after cleanup work
verify no dependency drift was introduced by incremental route or component changes
